bio.title: Background
bio.body: Dr. Jihad S. Husseini practises cosmetic dentistry, endodontics, and prosthetic and implant dentistry. Having all three under one roof means a case that starts as a cosmetic consultation can continue as root canal therapy or an implant without a referral — the same hand, and the same plan, from start to finish.

philosophy.title: Treatment philosophy
philosophy.body: Every treatment begins with a diagnosis you can see for yourself and a plan in plain language: what it involves, what it costs, and what the alternatives are. Comfort is part of that plan rather than an afterthought.
